title: Wall Mount Soap Dish Solid Brass 4.5-Inch Dottingham Collection | Allied Brass
short_title: Wall Mount Soap Dish 4.5-Inch Solid Brass | Allied Brass
description:
Upgrade your bathroom sink or shower area with a wall mount soap dish that keeps soap off the counter and within easy reach. Crafted from solid brass, this Dottingham collection accessory uses concealed screw mounting for a clean, coordinated look.

Highlights:
- Wall mounted design helps keep countertops clean and clutter-free
- Solid brass construction for enduring everyday use
- Concealed screw hardware for a neat, finished installation
- Includes brass soap dish holder and installation hardware
- Designed to coordinate with the Dottingham collection

Specs:
- Overall size: 4.5-Inch L x 3.5-Inch W x 3-Inch H; 5-Inch projection
- Weight capacity: 2 lb
- Product weight: 1.6 lb
- Mounting type: wall mount (assembly not required)
- Screw size: #8 x 1 1/4
- Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
- Finish options: available in a wide variety of designer finishes
